properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 6:46PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 645 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong wind producing
thunderstorms along a line extending from 7 miles northwest of The
Saunders Elevator to near Walsh to 11 miles northwest of Campo.
Movement was southeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Walsh, Vilas, Campo, and Stonington.
